newsitem.title: USA: Stanley Works plans 150 job cuts - report.
newsitem.headline: Stanley Works plans 150 job cuts - report.

text.p: Hand tool and industrial manufacturer Stanley Works plans to cut 150 jobs and move some of its operations out of Connecticut, the Hartford Courant reported on Thursday.
Spokesmen at Stanley Works, the second-biggest industrial employer in the Hartford area, were not immediately available to comment.
The report, which cited unidentified company employees, said the cuts would occur in the next month, and some operations worth $23 million in annual production would move to Virginia or Asia.
The company employs about 1,700 people in New Britain and Farmington, Conn.
Stanley Works' stock fell 12.5 cents to $36.875 on the New York Stock Exchange in late morning trading.
